notes:
Video Studio now lets you hear the complete recording before any picture renders. Listen to the song, narration, dialogue or scene sound in the player. Choose **Use this song** or **Use this audio** to render with that exact recording. **Make another song** or **Make another take** keeps your prompt and records again.

Pending takes stay in Recent clips across restarts. The GPU is available for other work while a take waits. New audio for extensions includes the existing opening so you can hear the transition.

Verified the queue, recovery and repeat decisions in native tests. Five FFmpeg timeline tests compared the encoded audio in the preview and the exported clip. This release uses the performer rendering behavior from the previous stable release.

[Source commit c11a4490](https://github.com/CaleMediaDev/cale-ai-workbench/commit/c11a4490c75f214e2dfe5d6fdb3a91041b69c3ca)
Verified with local models on Windows. The player reopened a pending movie, generated a different second take, and rendered the selected recording. Its encoded audio matched the preview byte for byte. The player also opened a two-person interview and a techno song before rendering. [Clean installation checks](https://github.com/CaleMediaDev/cale-ai-workbench-downloads/actions/runs/45542438878).
